tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You and your friend John are planning a trip to Europe. Write an email to John about your ideas for the trip.
bullets: Describe the destinations you have researched.
Explain why you think the trip would be enjoyable.
Ask for John's opinion and additional ideas.
tasks.subject: Europe Trip Planning
tasks.sample:
Hi John,

I have been looking at a few places for our Europe trip. I think we could start in Paris, then take a train to Amsterdam, and finish in Berlin. All three cities have walkable centers and good student hostels.

This route would be enjoyable because we could see museums, try local food, and travel between cities without flying. The trains are frequent, so we would not waste time at airports.

What do you think of this plan? Do you want to add another city, or would you rather spend more days in one place?

Talk soon,
Alex
tasks.analysis: 邮件需覆盖三点：已调研的目的地、为何好玩、征求 John 的意见和补充想法。
tasks.title: Europe Trip Planning

tasks.instruction: Write a discussion response. An effective response contains at least 100 words.

professor.name: Dr. Gupta
professor.text: We've been discussing the impact of cultural globalization on local traditions. Some anthropologists argue it leads to a loss of unique and diverse identities. Others believe it promotes exchange and understanding. What is your perspective on the impact of cultural globalization on local traditions?

posts.name: Kelly
posts.text: Cultural globalization can lead to the loss of unique cultural identities. As global culture becomes more dominant, traditional practices and languages can be forgotten or replaced. It's important to preserve and celebrate local culture to maintain identity.

posts.name: Andrew
posts.text: In my opinion, cultural globalization promotes cultural exchange and understanding. It allows people to learn about and appreciate different cultures. This exchange can lead to richer traditions and create a more interconnected and diverse world.

tasks.sample: I see both risks and benefits. Kelly is right that global brands and media can push local languages and festivals aside if communities do not protect them. At the same time, Andrew is right that contact with other cultures can make traditions richer rather than weaker. The key is who controls the exchange. When local people choose what to share and what to keep, globalization can spread music, food, and ideas without erasing identity. Schools and local media should support minority languages so that exchange does not become replacement.
tasks.analysis: 需表明立场并回应 Kelly（身份流失）与 Andrew（交流丰富传统）。较好答法：由本地人主导交流，保护语言与习俗。
tasks.title: Cultural Globalization
